rule: Sam, 2026-11-17, relayed by COBIx on #3358 section 2: collect with gaps noted and confidence scores; Commons Clarity's Part B (#3480, comment 6967374303); COBIx's D2 decision (major total differs, about 30); S739 (lane 1, the lever): Cosumnes River 33542 and East Los Angeles 33013, each held by earlier sessions, collected with the gap its own notes name (no reread, no reconcile, no record change)

gaps.noted_figures_differ: The reader's notes quote two figures from the catalog page that disagree, and the record's units add to one and state the other; no page read has settled which the program requires.
gaps.option_lists_read_apart: An option the catalog prints takes more than one list under the option's own printed figure, and the record's one option group holds each list as an alternative of its own, so the program's units cannot be checked against the printed figures.

records.words: Option II consists of two blocks (SPAN 413 and 415 required, plus a minimum of 8 units from a list); both carry option_group 'Option' together with Option I. The catalog prints 'OPTION II - Native Spanish Speaker Units: 16' for the two together; Option I is 16 units. Each option path prints 'Total Units: 19'.

outcomes: utilize correct grammatical structures of standard Spanish.
read Spanish proficiently as found, for example, in Spanish language newspapers, magazines, short stories, essays, and selections of poetry written by Spanish, Spanish-American, and Chicano authors.
demonstrate appropriate writing and composition skills using Spanish.
discuss and critique Spanish-American literature in a historical context.
demonstrate proficiency in these areas: comprehension, speaking, reading, writing, and understanding the peoples and cultures of Spanish-speaking countries.

blocks.name: A minimum of 3 units from the following
OPTION II - Native Spanish Speaker: A minimum of 8 units from the following

records.words: Core prints 'ANTHRO 101 OR ANTHRO 101 AND ANTHRO 111**', i.e. the lab ANTHRO 111 is optional; recorded as two option blocks. The catalog's core subtotal is 9-10 units for ANTHRO 101(+111), 102 and 103 together; not placed on any single block.

outcomes: Distinguish a culturally relativistic explanation of human behavior from an ethnocentric one.
Identify the general path of human evolution and the evidence in support of it.
Utilize empiricism, scientific principles, and/ or the scientific method in order to analyze data from an anthropological perspective.
program.electives_fill_words: ADDITIONAL CSU UNITS, IF NEEDED, TO REACH 60 CSU TRANSFERABLE UNITS

blocks.name: Required Core Courses: ANTHRO 101 AND ANTHRO 111

representation: checks.gaps and checks.confidence added as the load reads the filed score; checks.coverage, invented, arithmetic and the record unchanged
claim_check_reads: Today's capture (sources.json): every course an entry names among the codes it found. The capture keeps no page text, so a note's quoted figures are the reader's words, never re-read here.
follow_verdict: The follow_verdict trigger marks a row checked when its latest verdict is a confirm whose fingerprint matches the record and the machine checks pass. The record is unchanged here, so such a confirm on a row this plan moves to passing would check it at the apply, and the rollback would skip it. The pre-read counts those rows (confirm_matches); the apply aborts, writing nothing, unless the count is 0.
